method: Classical conforming NeoPZ RT0/P0 mixed Darcy
hdiv_family: EHDivConstant, polynomial order zero; three triangular flux functions and one constant pressure
dirichlet: p=1 at y=0 and p=0 at y=2200, natural mixed functional
neumann: q dot n=0 at x=0 and x=1200, exact flux-coefficient elimination; no penalty
material_integration: Each triangle lies in one constant-coefficient region; quadratic RT0 mass is integrated exactly
solver: Intel MKL PARDISO through pypardiso; native NeoPZ element assembly and field evaluation
linear_solver_coordinate_scaling: Eight symmetric Ruiz equilibration steps, final residual in unscaled physical equations
timing_scope: Observed wall time without exclusive access; not a performance benchmark
sampling: Common pixel centers; positive-coordinate owner on grid boundaries, lower-right owner on diagonal ties. Profiles approach each 200-unit interval from within. Samples are not integrated error norms.

change_from_previous.integration: degree-two three-point triangle quadrature on the finer nested grid; finer reference norm denominator
